On Chytron Street

At Chytron 17 in Nicosia, with tables outside. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30 to 18:00 and Saturday from 8:00 to 16:00. Closed on Sunday.

What guests say

Three of 74 Google reviews, all 74 with five stars.

“Amazing traditional bakery with authentic flavors and fresh products every day. The bread, pastries, and sweets taste homemade with so much care. Friendly service and a cozy atmosphere, highly recommended!!”

Google review
“A lovely café with friendly and attentive staff, delicious food, and aromatic coffee. I come here almost every day and will definitely keep coming back!”

Google review
“I popped into this coffee shop the other day and ended up liking it more than I expected. It’s got a really cozy, easygoing feel—one of those places where you just naturally slow down a bit. The coffee was really good, smooth and actually enjoyable to drink, not just something to grab and go. And the staff were genuinely nice, which made it feel even more welcoming. It’s a simple place, but in a good way. I’d definitely go back.”
